rules: Historical knowledge must functionally support the thesis and required components.
organizer_interpretations: First explicitly selected essay topic only, including word count.
Exact word-count preprocessing and final-answer extraction are benchmark procedures.

method: Parsed HTML article.review-task, task-score and grade-explanation. Reconciled unique IDs, score sums and maxima with page headline. Public JSON retains score facts/links and reason hashes; full explanations/source material remain in ignored outputs. Taxonomy is manually selected representative evidence, not automated causal frequency counts. No independent regrading of951answers.
limitations: AI benchmark grades are not official examiner results.
Different modes, models, revisions, precision, decoding and budgets confound direct performance comparisons.
No source/answer/grade content may enter training or retrieval.
No May2025 read; no inference/training calls.
